## isNotTypeOf() function

Check that a value's type \*does not\* match one or more types.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function isNotTypeOf<T, U extends Primitive[]>(value: T, ...types: U): value is Exclude<T, TypeOf<U>>;
```
